qb.notes: Hurts started and finished Week 1. Andy Dalton was the active No. 2 in Week 1; Tanner McKee was inactive as the emergency third QB. No QB injury.

injuries.injury: Right knee bone bruise (rolled up on in camp practice); played through it in Week 1, placed on IR Sept 14 - out at least through Week 5, earliest return Week 6
Pectoral strain suffered lifting weights just before camp; missed all of camp, returned to practice Week 1 (limited) and was ruled out vs WAS. Could make Eagles debut Week 2 at TEN; no firm word yet
Quadriceps and hamstring injuries; rookie 2nd-round pick ruled out Week 1 and placed on IR Sept 12 - misses at least four games

context_notes: Drew Kendall (2025 5th-round pick) is expected to start at LG in place of Dickerson against Jeffery Simmons and the Titans DL.

WR Hollywood Brown played zero offensive snaps in Week 1 and was not used on special teams; Sirianni said the team will 'make a better effort' to get him involved in Week 2. Dontayvion Wicks operated as WR2.
Rookie WR Makai Lemon played a heavy snap share in Week 1 that local coverage expects to be scaled back.
SI headline references Sirianni responding to a C.J. Gardner-Johnson ejection in the Week 1 game (details not confirmed via search).
Eagles won 24-22 but ESPN analysts were unimpressed; opponent Titans have a new HC (Robert Saleh).

qb.notes: Ward (team captain) started Week 1 and was healthy; overwhelmed by pressure behind a struggling OL. Trubisky listed No. 2 on the depth chart; Will Levis and Hendon Hooker were waived at cutdown (Hooker to practice squad).

injuries.injury: Concussion from a UTV accident the weekend before Week 1; missed Week 1 vs NYJ. HC Robert Saleh said Monday he has cleared protocol and should be available vs PHI
Evaluated for a concussion during Week 1 after a teammate was pushed into him on a punt return; cleared and returned to the game (later lost a fumble on a kickoff return)
Brief right shoulder injury in the preseason; returned to practice before Week 1 and had no game designation

context_notes: First season under new HC Robert Saleh; Titans lost their opener despite a busy offseason and open with two home games (PHI next).
Offense could not sustain drives; OL gave up steady pressure on Ward, who scrambled 4 times for 21 yards. Eagles pass rush expected to feast.
Rookie LB Anthony Hill Jr. and James Williams filled in for Gray in Week 1; Mohamoud Diabate was elevated for depth.
Cedric Gray was the only Titan with a game designation on the Week 1 report.

qb.notes: Lawrence 18/23, 245 yds, 4 TD, 0 INT (150.6 rating) in Week 1; healthy. Nick Mullens was elevated from the practice squad as the Week 1 backup; Quinn Ewers was inactive (emergency QB) - too new to the roster.

injuries.injury: Shoulder - reaggravated a pre-existing shoulder issue in the 2nd quarter of Week 1, returned to finish the game; limited in practice this week, HC Liam Coen 'fully imagines' he plays at DEN
Elbow injury in the 1st quarter of Week 1 vs CLE, did not return; not expected to play at DEN in Week 2
Hip - missed much of camp, questionable for Week 1 but active and played vs CLE

context_notes: Week 1 inactives: QB Quinn Ewers, S Jalen Huskey, TE Tanner Koziol, OL Daniel Faalele, DE Bryan Thomas Jr., DE Wesley Williams - all healthy scratches.
RT Cole Van Lanen (knee), WR Jakobi Meyers (thumb) and LT Anton Harrison (foot) carried Week 1 report tags but all were active with no designation.
Travis Hunter played 29 defensive snaps at CB and only 4 on offense in Week 1; local coverage says the two-way experiment is 'flopping' but the team looked dominant regardless.
Defense posted 5 sacks and 2 takeaways; TD catches by Parker Washington, Josh Cameron, Brenton Strange and Jakobi Meyers.

qb.notes: Nix (back from the 2025 season-ending ankle fracture) started and finished the Monday-night loss; no injury reported. Stidham is the primary backup.

injuries.injury: Hip - left on the 2nd drive vs KC (questionable to return), went to the locker room briefly and returned to the game. Had also carried a foot injury from the preseason finale (full participant in Week 1)

context_notes: Broncos had no injury designations entering Week 1 and Mims was the only in-game injury found.
Offense was described as a Payton-era low: 218 total yards, 3-of-12 on third down; Payton said the loss 'starts with me, starts with our coaching staff.'
Short week after Monday night; Payton said prep 'becomes a little more mental' with film review Tuesday before turning to JAX at home Sept 20.

qb.notes: Cousins threw 3 TD in his Raiders debut (300th career TD pass) under new HC Klint Kubiak; healthy. Rookie Fernando Mendoza was the active backup and did not play. (Geno Smith is no longer with the Raiders - now with the Jets.)

injuries.injury: Knee - meniscus trim on Sept 8, missed Week 1; Kubiak said Monday he is day-to-day and the team believes there is a realistic chance he returns Week 2 at LAC
Foot - limped off late in Week 1 vs MIA and did not finish; replaced by rookie 5th-rounder Zeke Masses. Kubiak called him day-to-day
Placed on injured reserve before Week 1; must miss at least the first four games
Ankle sprain in the preseason; full participant in Week 1 practices, started and starred vs MIA

context_notes: First regular-season game of the Klint Kubiak era; Cousins-Jeanty two-pronged attack overwhelmed Miami.
Michael Mayer handled the starting TE role with Bowers out; if Bowers is limited again Mayer stays the primary target at TE.
Porter was the only in-game injury of note; Kubiak's Monday tone suggested neither Bowers nor Porter is expected to miss much time.

qb.notes: Herbert started and finished the upset loss; no injury. Per Next Gen Stats he averaged 8.9 yds/att before McConkey left and 3.9 after. Trey Lance won the preseason backup battle over DJ Uiagalelei per local coverage (backup listing based on preseason reporting).

injuries.injury: Rib/chest - took a hard legal hit from ARI LB Mack Wilson late in the 3rd quarter of Week 1 (5-82-1 before exiting), did not return; Harbaugh says day-to-day, status vs LV up in the air
Hamstring in Week 1; Harbaugh said it 'looks like he's going to miss some time' and IR is being considered
Hamstring in Week 1 vs ARI; day-to-day per Harbaugh
Knee (ACL damage plus other structural damage) suffered in the preseason; placed on IR at cutdown, long-term absence
Abdomen - did not practice all of Week 1 and was inactive vs ARI; no Week 2 update found (4th CB / core special-teamer)
Hip - limited all of Week 1 practice, listed questionable, but played vs ARI

context_notes: Stunning home loss to Arizona; Herbert and the offensive line struggled (line already without Biadasz at center).
New OC Mike McDaniel in his first season with the Chargers.
Week 1 healthy scratches included OL Trevor Penning, OL Alex Harkey, OL Logan Taylor and S RJ Mickens; rookie S Genesis Smith was active over Mickens.
Bowers (LV) could be back for this game, which changes the Chargers' defensive matchup at TE.

SEA.week1_result: W 13-10 vs NE (Wed Sept 9 kickoff game)

qb.notes: Sam Darnold started Week 1 but left on the opening possession (5 snaps) with a right hip injury, later described by Mike Macdonald as 'an unusual muscle strain in his hip area' / glute. MRI showed no fracture; IR not being considered. Multiple reports (NFL Network, Rapoport) say he will miss Week 2 at ARI and could return as soon as Week 3 vs WAS, though some reports float 4-6 weeks. Drew Lock (16/22, 187 yds, 1 TD in relief) starts; Jalen Milroe (Week 1 emergency QB) moves to backup and Seattle is expected to add a third QB.

injuries.injury: Right hip/glute muscle strain on the first series of Week 1 vs NE; expected to miss Week 2, possible Week 3 return, 4-6 weeks per some reports; not going on IR
Ankle surgery before camp; limited in Week 1 practice, listed questionable and inactive vs NE - has not yet made 2026 debut
Hamstring; limited in Week 1 practice, listed questionable and inactive vs NE - has not yet made 2026 debut

context_notes: Super Bowl LX rematch; Seattle won 13-10 with Lock leading a comeback after Darnold's exit.
Emmanwori's absence was noticeable against New England's short passing game; his return would be a meaningful boost vs ARI.
Seattle has an extra-long week (Wednesday game) before the Sept 20 trip to Arizona, which upset LAC 26-14 in Week 1.
Odds movement: the Darnold news shifted the Week 2 line at ARI.

qb.notes: Brissett (27/37, 277 yds, 1 TD) started and won at LAC; healthy. Kyler Murray is no longer with Arizona - he is the Vikings' QB and entered concussion protocol after his Minnesota debut. Rookie 3rd-round pick Carson Beck is reported as the No. 2 (one source also mentions Gardner Minshew II; backup listing not fully confirmed).

Torn MCL in the preseason; 2nd-round rookie on IR, potentially season-ending
Undisclosed - ruled out for Week 1 (HC Mike LaFleur: 'trending well' but not ready); Jon Gaines II started at RG. No Week 2 update found
Returning from a serious injury; ruled out for Week 1. No Week 2 update found
Ruled out for Week 1 (injury not specified in results). No Week 2 update found

context_notes: New HC Mike LaFleur's debut was a 26-14 upset at LAC; Trey McBride 9-95-1, Tyler Allgeier and rookie Jeremiyah Love split RB work with Conner on IR.
LB Mack Wilson delivered the hit that knocked LAC WR Ladd McConkey out of the game.
The Week 2 line vs SEA moved after Darnold was ruled out; Seattle's coverage says the Cardinals can no longer be taken lightly.
